description: Jeles research pass 2026-09-02 BEFORE treating sovereign-ai intake as settleable. Web (ddg) + institutional fan-out + verify_claim. verify_claim matched:true with low/zero overlap on several claims — treat as findable-not-verified.

findings.question: ASML / TSMC / NVIDIA chokepoint chain
findings.notes: Web + institutional hits consistently describe ASML as sole cutting-edge EUV supplier; TSMC as leading foundry; NVIDIA fabless. SSRN 2026 'Beyond the Picks and Shovels' (ASML/TSMC durability) is on-theme. verify_claim ASML sole supplier: matched=true but overlap=0.06 — DO NOT treat as verified.

findings.question: Stargate equity funders SoftBank/OpenAI/Oracle/MGX Jan 2025
findings.notes: OpenAI + SoftBank press name SoftBank, OpenAI, Oracle, MGX as initial equity funders; SoftBank financial / OpenAI operational; Son chair. Wikipedia Stargate LLC agrees. verify_claim returned wrong arxiv hit (overlap 0.0) — ignore that match.

findings.question: DeepSeek V3 ~$5–6M training / High-Flyer A100 stockpile
findings.notes: Public discourse repeats ~$5.6M for V3 final training run GPU cost; SemiAnalysis and others argue total GPU investment much higher (>$500M class). A100 ~10k cluster attributed to High-Flyer pre-controls appears widely but is secondary reporting. Intake must NOT equate $5.6M with total program cost.

findings.question: Hugging Face Series D investors include Google Amazon NVIDIA Salesforce
findings.notes: TechCrunch/CNBC Aug 2023: $235M Series D, ~$4.5B valuation; participants include Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Intel, AMD, Qualcomm, IBM, Salesforce, Sound Ventures. Essay claim holds; AMD/Qualcomm/IBM also in list.

findings.question: European digital / AI sovereignty literature
findings.notes: Institutional search surfaces academic work on digital sovereignty and AI political economy (e.g. European Digital Sovereignty layered approach; Digital Disintegration techno-blocs). Supports that 'sovereignty' is contested academic/policy term — aligns with essay's rhetorical-vs-operational distinction, does not prove five pillars.

pairs.source_text: What did the 2026-09-02 Jeles research pass find about The Illusion of Sovereign AI chokepoint claims?
pairs.target_text: Hardware chain (NVIDIA design → TSMC fab → ASML EUV) is widely corroborated in open web and institutional hits (including SSRN on ASML/TSMC durability). Stargate initial equity funders SoftBank/OpenAI/Oracle/MGX are corroborated by OpenAI and SoftBank primary press (Jan 2025). Hugging Face Series D participation by Google/Amazon/NVIDIA/Salesforce et al. is corroborated by TechCrunch/CNBC (Aug 2023). DeepSeek '$5–6M' figure is contested: often final-run GPU rental, not total GPU investment (SemiAnalysis and cost breakdowns warn against equating them). corpus_verify_claim returned matched:true with near-zero overlap on ASML/Stargate checks — findable ≠ verified. Essay thesis pairs remain novel/asserted until a human seals after reading this pass.
